$comment: Asset store catalog (SPEC §4.9) — DATA, not code. Store content in three forms: hosted scenes referenced by URL, interactive prefabs (GLTF carrying CVTOOLS_unity_metadata, instantly usable via InstantiatePrefabFromContainer), and downloadable file packs. `premium` items are Stripe-gated (one-time). Authored with the Babylon Toolkit Unity Exporter — the store's content pipeline IS the Pro toolchain. This seed list is expanded as content ships; user uploads are NOT here (they live in the user_assets table).

scenes.title: Open Terrain
scenes.description: A large outdoor terrain with sky and lighting — drop a character or vehicle straight in.

scenes.title: Sample Scene
scenes.description: A neutral starter environment good for prototyping any genre.

prefabs.title: Drivable Car
prefabs.description: A car prefab wired with StandardCarController — instantly drivable on instantiation.

packs.title: Low-Poly Nature Pack
packs.description: Trees, rocks, and foliage props for outdoor scenes. Downloads into public/assets/.
